linkedin:
Only 23% of the 4,441 remote jobs on Loker Dollar list a pay figure. Here's what the data shows.

We analyzed 4,441 active remote listings and found:
- 1,000 listings (23%) disclose compensation; 3,441 (77%) keep it private
- 2,753 (62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world
- Communication is the top required skill (1,662 listings, 39%), followed by AI (517, 12%) and leadership (416, 10%)
- 1,560 distinct companies are hiring, but only Neo Financial (bilingual client services at $5 USD/hour) reveals its pay

The takeaway: missing pay doesn't mean low wages. Many firms expect candidates to negotiate.

Filter Loker Dollar by "worldwide remote" to see the 2,753 location-agnostic openings before they close.

https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
